title: astragalus longissimus
intro: Astragalus longissimus, commonly known as the long bean Astragalus, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include immune system support, anti-inflammatory properties, and cardiovascular health promotion. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus longissimus include immune modulation, anti-oxidation, and anti-viral activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, saponins, and polysaccharides. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and anti-viral properties, making Astragalus longissimus a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
